text:
ana: Start thread for tonight's cutover for agent.semantic_v2_enable. Change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Plan: canary -> small cohort -> broad ramp. Canary=0.5% for 15m, then 3% for 15m, then 15% for 30m, then 60% -> 100% with manual check at 60%. Deploy-bot will handle percentages.
jon: sounds good. Request: keep internal-cohort "dev-team" pinned to v2 for the whole window so we can run A/B checks.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled at 2025-08-03T02:00:00Z. Will checkpoint metrics and post a snapshot after each step. Will respect manual holdpoints.
kmiller: Rollback triggers (add to runbook): 1) user-facing error spike: 5xx rate > 1.0% sustained for 3m, 2) model quality regression: BLEU drop > 8 pts on eval set or > 10% increase in nonsensical completion rate, 3) memory OOMs on gpu nodes. On any trigger: disable flag, pin traffic back to previous route, and open incident channel.
oncall-lee: I'll be oncall. If deploy-bot pauses for a holdpoint and I don't ack within 4m, policy is to auto-disable the feature flag. I'll be reachable @lee.
sre-alex: ops commands to disable/pin quickly: 
```
# disable flag immediately
curl -s -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN\" \\
  https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/agent.semantic_v2_enable/disable
# pin traffic back to stable-route
curl -s -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN\" \\
  https://ops.redwood/api/v1/pins -d '{"service":"llm-route","version":"v1.8"}'
# verify
curl -s https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/agent.semantic_v2_enable | jq .status
```
kmiller: Note: deploy-bot has scoped permission to run the disable call if oncall codes approve. Also added automations to annotate the incident with telemetry dump.
nana: Can we reserve 7% spare capacity in ap-south to avoid autoscaler thrash? If traffic jumps we want headroom.
sre-alex: yes setting regional reserve=7% for ap-south; will push config before run.
jon: release notes snippet for PM: "Gradual rollout of semantic v2 to improve agent response relevance and reduce hallucinations. Monitoring enabled; will expand to all users after validation." Keep short and product-friendly.
nana: Also add a short internal note on session stickiness: when we transition >50% we pin session-routing for 2h to avoid model flips mid-session: /ops/pin-sessions route=llm-route version=v2.0 duration=2h
deploy-bot: preflight smoke ran at 01:10 UTC, passed quick latency and error checks. Ready. Will pause on any holdpoint and post stack traces if runtime OOM detected.
kmiller: small ops tweak: if we see latency P50 jump > 200ms but P95 stable, treat as observation not rollback. Only P95 regressions or user errors should trigger immediate disable.
oncall-lee: ack. I'll monitor metrics dashboard and semantic eval slack alert. If I don't respond in 4m, auto-disable kicks in.
nana: final sanity: if all green at 15% for two consecutive windows (so 15m + 15m) we may compress next steps to 30m total for the 60->100 shift, but only with oncall approval.
jon: noted. I'll coordinate acceleration if needed.
sre-alex: logging: deploy-bot will tag each event with rollout_id=20250803_semantic_v2 and attach a small telemetry pack (error-rate, latencies, sample diffs).
deploy-bot: acknowledged. Starting runbook entry creation in /runbooks/releases/2025-08-03-semantic-v2.txt
ana: thanks. Posting final ramp summary after window. Good luck everyone. :rocket:
